source_scope: tracked production source and V1 schema at base_sha; tests and generated typed-schema files excluded from classification rows

storage_tables.current_owner: Commerce schema; runtime catalog is hard-coded

storage_tables.target_owner: Entitlement grants and Quota configuration/usage projections

inventory.current_role: Shared counter table with tenant/feature indexes but no unique tenant-feature constraint or period/idempotency columns.
inventory.rationale: The current shape cannot enforce single-row identity, idempotency, period, or atomic conditional consumption.
inventory.migration_action: Add clean-forward canonical quota ledger/counter identity and constraints; backfill and reconcile before writer switch.
inventory.guard_requirement: Exactly one target writer and no direct Render/deprecated write after C2.

inventory.current_role: Entitlement-owned read and update-then-insert writer to quota_usage.
inventory.rationale: Closest owning boundary, but read-modify/set and non-atomic update-then-insert are unsafe under concurrency.
inventory.migration_action: Replace setUsage with atomic idempotent consume/adjust commands behind the sole QuotaUsageAuthority.
inventory.guard_requirement: Canonical candidate for quota_usage; direct callers limited to QuotaUsageAuthority.

inventory.current_role: In-memory cache plus non-atomic get-plus-set persistent usage writer.
inventory.rationale: Cache and persistence can diverge and increment races can lose updates.
inventory.migration_action: Replace with transactionally atomic commands and read projections; remove cache as authority.
inventory.guard_requirement: No getUsage + delta + setUsage writer sequence after C2.

inventory.current_role: Quota admission and post-use mutation facade.
inventory.target_authority: Quota decision/read projection plus QuotaUsageAuthority command port
inventory.rationale: Evaluation and mutation are valid Quota concerns but need atomic reserve/consume semantics and typed principal/period keys.
inventory.migration_action: Split pure decision projection from command path while preserving a single authority.
inventory.guard_requirement: No runtime capacity or price input in quota decisions.

inventory.current_role: Render-owned read-modify-write and insert against the same quota_usage table.
inventory.rationale: This is the concrete second table writer and loses updates under concurrency.
inventory.migration_action: Route Render consumption to QuotaUsageAuthority then delete repository.
inventory.guard_requirement: No QUOTA_USAGE update/insert under render-module after C2.

inventory.current_role: Render-local quota policy with hard-coded DEFAULT_LIMIT and local consumption writer.
inventory.rationale: Render must not own commercial limits or usage mutation.
inventory.migration_action: Replace admission calls with H5 decision port and consumption with canonical quota command.
inventory.guard_requirement: Render owns no DEFAULT_LIMIT or commercial quota mutation.

inventory.current_role: Calls Render billing engine/fallback and then independently calls RenderQuotaService.
inventory.target_authority: Consumer of combined H1 + H5 admission decision
inventory.rationale: Current path can evaluate commercial state multiple times through competing engines.
inventory.migration_action: Use one server-side admission intersection; keep technical and commercial reasons typed separately.
inventory.guard_requirement: No direct BillingDecisionEngine, BillingEnforcementService, or RenderQuotaService commercial admission.

inventory.current_role: Reserves Render billing credits before execution and consumes Render quota on completion.
inventory.target_authority: H5 admission, ObservedRuntimeUsage emitter, and canonical quota command client
inventory.rationale: Commercial reservation is conflated with execution flow and quota mutation bypasses the target owner.
inventory.migration_action: Replace with typed H5 decision token and post-execution observation/consumption commands.
inventory.guard_requirement: No Render-owned commercial reservation or quota writer.

inventory.current_role: Deprecated in-memory buckets, usage records, policies, threshold events, and idempotency map.
inventory.rationale: Javadoc says merged into Entitlement, yet the service still mutates commercial quota state.
inventory.migration_action: Migrate remaining reads/callers and remove module/API/domain/tests in clean-forward phase.
inventory.guard_requirement: No imports of com.example.platform.quota after C2/C8.

inventory.current_role: Keeps deprecated quota module in the build graph.
inventory.rationale: Physical inclusion contradicts completed semantic merge and enables continued callers.
inventory.migration_action: Remove include only after callers and module artifacts are retired with proof.
inventory.guard_requirement: Removal is required at C8, not in this docs lane.

inventory.current_role: Typed immutable append-only operation usage fact with provenance and idempotency.
inventory.target_authority: ObservedRuntimeUsage contract owned by runtime observation boundary
inventory.rationale: Mechanics are strong, but ObservedRuntimeUsage is not Billing-owned BillableUsage.
inventory.migration_action: Rename/rehome observation contract; add explicit BillableUsage output with lineage.
inventory.guard_requirement: ObservedRuntimeUsage and BillableUsage remain distinct types and owners.

inventory.current_role: Idempotent append-only usage persistence using ON CONFLICT and typed base units.
inventory.rationale: Persistence idempotency is reusable; package ownership and incomplete persisted fields require redesign.
inventory.migration_action: Preserve insert/idempotency mechanics while moving to complete observation schema/owner.
inventory.guard_requirement: No mutation of observations and no quantity double authority.

inventory.current_role: Runtime producer of REQUEST and DURATION facts with attempt-scoped idempotency.
inventory.rationale: Correct producer responsibility and idempotency mechanics; contract type must be rehomed.
inventory.migration_action: Adopt rehomed observation port without adding price or billability logic.
inventory.guard_requirement: Runtime emitter never imports price, subscription, entitlement, or billing decisions.

inventory.current_role: Render-local duration plus floating cost writer to render_usage_record.
inventory.rationale: Duplicates typed observation path, combines usage with price/cost, and uses floating money.
inventory.migration_action: Backfill/reconcile if populated, switch readers, then drop repository/table.
inventory.guard_requirement: No render_usage_record or double cost usage writer after C8.

inventory.current_role: In-memory manual usage recorder that rounds double quantity into the observation type.
inventory.rationale: Current service neither normalizes immutable observations nor persists distinct BillableUsage lineage.
inventory.migration_action: Consume ObservedRuntimeUsage by ID and emit deterministic BillableUsage; remove direct manual observation authority.
inventory.guard_requirement: No double quantity-to-billing shortcut and no random idempotency fallback.

inventory.current_role: Selects a pricing rule and rates the current canonical UsageRecord directly.
inventory.rationale: The consumer boundary is useful, but it must accept normalized BillableUsage rather than raw observations.
inventory.migration_action: Change input contract and require metering rule/version lineage.
inventory.guard_requirement: Billing does not rate raw ObservedRuntimeUsage.

inventory.current_role: Render-local orchestration of subscription, two quota systems, policy, pricing, credits, and cost estimation.
inventory.rationale: It centralizes commercial authority in H1/Render and couples independent shadow stacks.
inventory.migration_action: Move admission policy to H5 ports and remove engine after caller cutover.
inventory.guard_requirement: No commercial decision engine under render-module.

inventory.current_role: Independent in-memory provider/tier/promotion customer-price calculator using doubles.
inventory.rationale: Duplicates Billing pricing, lets provider mechanics define customer price, and violates money precision.
inventory.migration_action: Map justified rules to integral Billing pricing; delete Render engine and types.
inventory.guard_requirement: No PricingEngine or customer price doubles under Render.

inventory.current_role: Independent in-memory promotional/referral credit accounts and deductions using doubles.
inventory.rationale: Duplicates CreditWalletService without durability, atomicity, integral money, or reconciliation.
inventory.migration_action: Reconcile any semantics into Billing credit commands, then delete.
inventory.guard_requirement: No Render credit balance or grant authority.

inventory.current_role: Legacy Render subscription/quota validation, credit reservation, usage recording, and billing finalization.
inventory.target_authority: None; H5 admission plus Billing/Usage ports
inventory.rationale: Combines multiple commercial authorities inside execution and retains float reservation/finalization.
inventory.migration_action: Cut callers to typed authority ports and remove service.
inventory.guard_requirement: No BillingEnforcementService caller after C7/C8.

inventory.current_role: Render-local mutable estimated/actual cost record writer using floating columns.
inventory.target_authority: None; ExecutionCost observations and Billing projections
inventory.rationale: Render-owned commercial record competes with Billing and overwrites finalization state.
inventory.migration_action: Reconcile to immutable cost/usage facts and Billing records, then drop writer/table.
inventory.guard_requirement: No RENDER_BILLING_RECORD writes after C8.

inventory.current_role: Provider execution-cost estimator with hard-coded profiles and double amounts.
inventory.rationale: Cost is distinct from price; double/hard-coded cost profiles are unsafe for canonical monetary output.
inventory.migration_action: Return typed integral Money cost evidence; keep optimizer consumption separate from pricing.
inventory.guard_requirement: ExecutionCost types cannot be used as CommercialPrice without explicit pricing rule.

inventory.current_role: Immutable idempotent provider cost fact using scale-0 BigDecimal minor units and currency.
inventory.rationale: Money and provenance mechanics are suitable, but logical ownership must remain distinct from CommercialPrice/Billing authority.
inventory.migration_action: Retain schema/mechanics while establishing explicit Cost authority and typed Money shared contract.
inventory.guard_requirement: Scale 0, currency, provenance, and idempotency remain mandatory.

inventory.current_role: Billing-owned pricing rules, custom overrides, discounts, and integral-minor outputs.
inventory.rationale: Correct logical owner and output units; persistence/versioning and decimal quantity rounding still require implementation hardening.
inventory.migration_action: Persist/version rules and replace floating percentage/quantity arithmetic with explicit decimal rounding policy.
inventory.guard_requirement: Only Billing emits customer-facing price results.

inventory.current_role: Billing-owned integral-minor decision DTO with generic string status/details.
inventory.rationale: Correct monetary representation but lacks the frozen typed rejection algebra and full authority evidence.
inventory.migration_action: Introduce typed decision/reason/principal/evidence contract; do not reuse Render decision.
inventory.guard_requirement: Required eight generic denial tokens exist and provider states do not leak.

inventory.current_role: Full SubscriptionPlan and SubscriptionContract update/insert repository.
inventory.rationale: It carries the fuller canonical contract model and tenant/plan fields; it must become the only contract writer.
inventory.migration_action: Route all subscription commands here; add state transition/idempotency/locking rules.
inventory.guard_requirement: Only this subordinate repository writes subscription_contract after C3.

inventory.current_role: Second jOOQ insert-only writer to subscription_contract with a narrower record shape.
inventory.rationale: Duplicates the same table and permits conflicting partial contract representations.
inventory.migration_action: Move reads to Subscription projection/repository, remove writes and class.
inventory.guard_requirement: No SUBSCRIPTION_CONTRACT insert outside SubscriptionJdbcRepository.

inventory.current_role: Projection-named service with in-memory defaults and command-like subscription/invoice writers.
inventory.rationale: A projection must not create authoritative contracts or invoices, and default active/pro state is fail-open.
inventory.migration_action: Delete mutation APIs/default active state; consume durable authority events into read models.
inventory.guard_requirement: Projection classes contain no repository save/insert calls.

inventory.current_role: Billing-owned invoice persistence in integral minor units and currency.
inventory.rationale: Correct owner and money shape; needs idempotent update/state-machine and reconciliation constraints.
inventory.migration_action: Place behind Billing command service and make projections read-only.
inventory.guard_requirement: Exactly one Billing invoice command authority.

inventory.current_role: Append-style Billing ledger entry persistence with minor units/currency/reference.
inventory.rationale: Correct owner and auditable money representation; idempotency and reversal links must be added.
inventory.migration_action: Add immutable idempotency/original-entry linkage and explicit adjustment types.
inventory.guard_requirement: Refund/reversal append entries; never overwrite financial history.

inventory.current_role: Commercial plan with price/currency and included quota map.
inventory.rationale: Plan is commercial and does not define capability contracts; included quota must reference Quota configuration.
inventory.migration_action: Keep plan separate from CapabilityContract and make catalog references typed/versioned.
inventory.guard_requirement: No plan enum/name inside canonical Capability or media types.

inventory.current_role: Payment-owned append persistence of provider reference/status/amount/currency and raw request/response payloads.
inventory.rationale: Correct owner and monetary shape; identity uniqueness, state transitions, payload isolation, and refunds require hardening.
inventory.migration_action: Add provider-scoped identity/idempotency and canonical state machine; move raw payload to adapter inbox reference.
inventory.guard_requirement: Only Payment writes transaction state; provider payload absent from generic events.

inventory.current_role: Provider routing, checkout/verification persistence, webhook validation/deduplication, and success dispatch.
inventory.rationale: Correct owner but catches persistence failures, derives dedupe keys from reference/type, stores raw bodies, and dispatches only success.
inventory.migration_action: Implement durable inbox claim/state transitions, typed all-state events, retries, refund/chargeback, and no swallowed writes.
inventory.guard_requirement: Duplicate/out-of-order/provider payload negative tests required.

inventory.current_role: Durable raw webhook inbox with unique key existence check.
inventory.rationale: Useful storage boundary, but check-then-insert is race-prone and processing outcome/ordering/digest/access controls are absent.
inventory.migration_action: Use atomic claim, provider event identity, processing state/outcome, occurred time, digest/reference, and retry semantics.
inventory.guard_requirement: No provider payload in canonical domain/projection output.

inventory.current_role: In-memory provider-reference to checkout/principal correlation map.
inventory.rationale: Restart loss and provider-reference-only keying can mis-correlate payment state and principals.
inventory.migration_action: Persist correlation as part of canonical payment attempt/transaction identity, then delete registry.
inventory.guard_requirement: No in-memory payment identity authority.

inventory.current_role: In-memory Billing-side payment ledger and float invoice/cost reconciliation.
inventory.rationale: Billing may reconcile payments but cannot own a peer transaction ledger; floating money and in-memory authority are unsafe.
inventory.migration_action: Replace payment map with immutable PaymentProjection references and integral Billing reconciliation entries.
inventory.guard_requirement: No PaymentLedgerEntry mutation in Billing; reconciliation remains Billing-owned.

inventory.current_role: Generic entitlement grant update/insert store with subject, bundle, quota profile, source, state, and term.
inventory.rationale: Correct logical authority and extensible source model; tenant scoping/idempotency/audit and direct writer restrictions need hardening.
inventory.migration_action: Place behind one grant command boundary and add canonical PrincipalRef/source identity/unique command key.
inventory.guard_requirement: Exactly one Entitlement grant command authority.

inventory.current_role: Write-through generic grant service plus in-memory grant/quota/snapshot authorities and event/audit side effects.
inventory.rationale: Correct owner but fallback caches split authority and current subject lookups/exception swallowing are fail-open/ambiguous.
inventory.migration_action: Make durable command transaction authoritative; derive caches/projections and typed outcomes after commit.
inventory.guard_requirement: No in-memory fallback as production grant authority and no payment event direct grant bypass.

inventory.current_role: Separate workspace-member grant store and state writer.
inventory.target_authority: Subordinate store behind Entitlement grant command boundary
inventory.rationale: Workspace scope is valid but must not become a peer authority or combine allocation quota with access grant semantics implicitly.
inventory.migration_action: Route commands through Entitlement authority; keep workspace grant projection/store only if distinct aggregate is justified.
inventory.guard_requirement: No controller/fulfillment direct repository writes.

inventory.current_role: Combines tier, overrides, workspace member grants/pools, generic grants, and collaboration access.
inventory.rationale: Sources are appropriate but current string reasons, mixed quota hints, and subject-only queries do not satisfy principal-filtered fail-closed decisions.
inventory.migration_action: Use PrincipalRef, typed reasons/evidence, tenant-scoped reads, and separate quota decision.
inventory.guard_requirement: Entitlement never claims runtime/provider availability.

inventory.current_role: Typed commercial limit configuration across render, storage, GPU, prompt, extension, API, and MCP dimensions.
inventory.rationale: Represents commercial limits, not runtime capacity; it is a suitable target-owner seed.
inventory.migration_action: Version limits/periods and reference them by typed quota keys; keep separate from capacity/reservation.
inventory.guard_requirement: No Worker/Device capacity fields or provider availability semantics.

inventory.current_role: Platform SKU/line type mapping to plan, tier, bundle, quota profile, credit/seat amount, and integral price.
inventory.rationale: Provider IDs are subordinate and money is integral; commercial references must remain inputs rather than capability semantics.
inventory.migration_action: Persist/version offerings and typed references; split price versions where necessary.
inventory.guard_requirement: No canonical Media/Capability type or plan-specific domain fork.

inventory.current_role: Hard-coded in-memory offerings and plan/tier/bundle/quota mappings.
inventory.rationale: Existing commerce tables are unused here and hard-coded offering state is not auditable/versioned.
inventory.migration_action: Load versioned persisted offerings and provider mappings; keep availability policy outside canonical capabilities.
inventory.guard_requirement: Catalog is sole offering identity source and emits no technical CAN_RUN decision.

inventory.current_role: Raw capability implementation discovery/contract registration authority explicitly named for Agent/MCP/Application consumers.
inventory.target_authority: H1 internal raw registry behind EffectiveCapabilityView for principal surfaces
inventory.rationale: The registry correctly disclaims entitlement/billing, but raw consumer exposure would bypass H5 filtering.
inventory.migration_action: Retain raw registry for internal resolution; route principal-facing enumeration through EffectiveCapabilityView.
inventory.guard_requirement: No principal-facing direct CapabilityRegistryPort access after C7.

inventory.current_role: Canonical pure fail-closed static provider legality authority.
inventory.rationale: It answers representability/compatibility and contains no commercial concerns.
inventory.migration_action: No semantic change; consume its proof as one term of final admission.
inventory.guard_requirement: No entitlement, billing, quota, plan, price, or payment import/reason.

inventory.current_role: Fail-closed mutable runtime/worker/host/device/capacity/reservation evaluator.
inventory.rationale: It owns technical runtime truth; capacity and resource reservation stay separate from commercial quota.
inventory.migration_action: No commercial change; provide RuntimeAvailable projection to final admission.
inventory.guard_requirement: No commercial denial token/import in RuntimeEligibilityReason or evaluator.

inventory.current_role: GraphQL-facing duplicate money DTO using double amount.
inventory.rationale: Floating money loses precision and creates a duplicate generic price type.
inventory.migration_action: Replace with amountMinor plus ISO currency projection from canonical Money.
inventory.guard_requirement: No double amount in money/price DTOs.

inventory.current_role: Billing-local duplicate payment ledger model using double amount and provider/payment state.
inventory.target_authority: None; PaymentProjection reference plus Billing ledger entries
inventory.rationale: Duplicates Payment transaction authority and violates money precision.
inventory.migration_action: Replace with Payment transaction reference and integral Billing reconciliation/reversal entries.
inventory.guard_requirement: Payment status remains Payment-owned; Billing stores reconciliation state only.

inventory.current_role: Generic Payment domain command carrying an untyped provider payload string.
inventory.target_authority: Provider adapter request plus generic canonical verification command
inventory.rationale: Provider-specific payload shapes must not be exposed by a generic canonical Payment command.
inventory.migration_action: Keep raw payload inside adapter/inbox and pass a bounded provider reference/digest to canonical application logic.
inventory.guard_requirement: No rawPayload/payload field in generic payment domain commands or events.

inventory.current_role: Public confirmation DTO accepts an untyped payload and forwards it to generic verification.
inventory.target_authority: Provider-specific adapter endpoint or reference-only generic confirmation
inventory.rationale: An unbounded generic payload couples the API/application contract to provider shapes and risks persistence leakage.
inventory.migration_action: Use provider adapter parsing at the edge and a canonical typed confirmation command internally.
inventory.guard_requirement: Provider payload is bounded, authenticated, and absent from canonical events/projections.
